about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.
plan: Shared by all eight shots: window 1440x763 (device-metrics override at scale 1) on the deployed Pages build of main at 1f24660, at https://lioreshai.github.io/breach-protocol-flash-next/?dev=1&seed=60. One page load is one deal, so a re-take reloads the url and never calls a second DEV.boot() inside a load (js/90_dev.js:21-22); the dice is pinned by the page itself from `?dev=1&seed=` (js/90_dev.js:26). **Two terms this plan now records that the older rows could not.** (1) `DEV.freeze(true)` is issued the moment the page answers, BEFORE any boot or startLevel: the live update loop draws from the same seeded stream, so a page left painting while the harness polls re-deals levels 2 and 3 from wherever its clock happened to land. Measured for #478: three loads of the same url without the freeze signed level 2 as 350870494 / 1978041996 / 1812275020; with it, every load reads 1812275020. (2) `S.t = 4` is pinned before the shutter. A frozen clock stops update() but not S.t, and the exit portal is drawn with `globalAlpha = 0.5 + 0.35 * Math.sin(S.t * 5)` (js/40_render.js:3152), so where that overlay is in frame the frame mean is a function of wall-clock: ABATOIR CORE read 60.38 unpinned and 72.46 pinned, three pinned passes agreeing to 0.01. Then, per level: boot through the page's own load-time boot (level 0) or DEV.boot() + startLevel(N, true) (levels 2, 3), DEV.freeze(true); S.t = 4; DEV.tick(30); P.hp = 100; banner('', 0); then DEV.cam(...) and one DEV.tick(1) per shot. The level's own hostiles are left standing (never DEV.clear()), the one exception being level0-enemies, which clears and poses on purpose and is therefore shot LAST in its page load. Captures are Chromium screenshots re-encoded to colour type 2 by tools/png_rgb.js. Reproducible by statistics, never by md5. **The audio term.** SND.init draws floor(sampleRate*1.5) seeded values before genLevel (#404), so the rate the page reads is part of the instrument. Seven rows were taken on a capture profile that exposed no audio device - SND.ac read null at every shutter - so they carry `sampleRate: null` and bind the deal they name on a machine that draws the same zero count; `STRICT=1 node tools/recap.js check` prints each as device-scoped. `level3-stack` (re-taken later, for #431) read 44100 and binds a machine with a 44100 Hz device instead, which is a narrower row, not a looser one. A capture that reads a rate narrows its row to one machine and one device.

shots.note: RE-TAKEN from the deployed page for #468; its own page load of the same url, and the one load in the pass that does not carry the level's own hostiles, because DEV.clear() drops them. Build proved off the wire as the other level-0 rows: twelve served blobs md5-match main at 1f24660. Route: freeze at load, S.t = 4, DEV.tick(30), P.hp = 100, DEV.cam(18.5, 5.5, floorAt(18.5, 5.5), 0.60, 0), DEV.clear(), DEV.spawn('grunt', 1, 6), DEV.tick(1). DEV.spawn reports the body it realised at (23.45, 8.89), cell (23, 8), range exactly 6.00 m on the camera's heading with why 'exact' - no clamp, no lateral rescue; its cell reads MAP.fz 0 like the camera and MAP.light 0.4223, e.anim pinned to 0 by DEV.spawn itself, HUD 1 LEFT. Frame mean 65.27, thirds 52.3 / 65.0 / 78.5, 0 of 763 rows under 24 and 0 under 34. The wall behind him is the #416 repaint, which is the surface this frame is now a picture of at combat range - the distance #416 asked a body to keep its structure out to.

RE-TAKEN from the deployed page for #468. The build is proved off the wire before the shutter: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs the deployed page served were md5-compared against main at 1f24660 and all twelve matched, so these pixels came off the page that serves that tree (#395, #420). Route: reload the url, DEV.freeze(true) at load, S.t = 4, banner('', 0), DEV.tick(30), P.hp = 100, then the dealt spawn seat read off the page - (18.5, 5.5) heading 0.60, the same seat the replaced row named. Layout 3105224175, the same deal. Seat reads MAP.light 0.8305, MAP.cz 16 (ceiling 4.00 over floor 0.00), MAP.ceilFix 2 so a fitting hangs in the seat's own cell, 8 hostiles, 23 props, 13 lights. Nearest props: a barrel 2.83 m off at (16.5, 3.5) and a crate 5.00 m out at (21.5, 1.5). Frame mean 65.31, thirds 52.4 / 65.0 / 78.5, 0 of 763 rows under 24 and 0 under 34. Two things moved against the replaced bytes (mean 63.94): the brick behind the barrel is the #416 repaint, whose cracks read as grooves rather than black pinpricks, and the ceiling lost the moss generator it used to share with the deck (#487), so the overhead surface is a dry slab. The deck under the crosshair is the near field #467 owns - a 1-2 texel footprint fetched by the anisotropic tap pair - and it reads as continuous grain rather than texel steps.

RE-TAKEN from the deployed page for #468, in its own page load (one url, one boot - a second DEV.boot() inside a load keeps drawing from the advanced stream). Build proved off the wire: all twelve served blobs md5-match main at 1f24660. Route: DEV.freeze(true) at load, DEV.boot(), startLevel(2, true), banner('', 0), S.t = 4, DEV.tick(30), P.hp = 100, then the dealt spawn seat. THE DEAL MOVED: this level's layout is 469427782 against the 1812275020 the replaced row named, because level generation changed on main since that build (#421, #422), so every coordinate in the old caption belongs to a room that is no longer dealt. This deal's seat is (17.5, 28.5) heading 0.60 on floor 0.00; its own cell reads MAP.light 0.8822, MAP.cz 16 with the ceiling solving at 4.00, MAP.ceilFix 2 (a fitting hangs in the seat's own cell), 4 hung panes, 40 props, 24 lights, 18 hostiles alive. Frame mean 69.72, thirds 52.1 / 69.3 / 87.9, 0 of 763 rows under 24 and 0 under 34.

The same seat, deal and page load as level2-abatoir, turned to the nearest hung fitting this deal puts within reach of the frame - which is how #413's ask is honoured here: the row names the fitting these bytes actually point at, not the one an older deal hung. Build proved off the wire as the seat row. MAP.ceilPanes holds FOUR entries on this layout; the nearest with d > 1.5 is at (20.12, 26.88), 3.08 m from the seat at bearing -0.5539 rad, lens at z 2.35 under a slab top of 4.00. Pose DEV.cam(seat, -0.5539, 194), where 194 px = atan2(2.35 - eyeZ 0.50, 3.08) * BH 359: the solve that puts that lens on the crosshair instead of the fixed 25 px the older row used. Frame mean 70.26, thirds 70.1 / 78.9 / 61.8, 0 of 763 rows under 24 and 0 under 34. At 3.08 m the fitting's own lens is ~37 degrees overhead, so the rod and the panel share the frame with a band of wall rather than the whole room (#413).
